messages:
Jordan: Quick triage — we need final GA acceptance for Private deployment next week. Primary outstanding items: SLA boundaries, pricing bands, monitoring runbooks, support routing. Can everyone call out blockers?
Maya: I can finish the customer-facing docs and support KB today. Need final SLA numbers from Sam.
Sam: Draft SLA: Dedicated 99.9% monthly, Private 99.5% (first 90d pilot). Error budget calc in my doc: https://vault.redwood/sla/private-sla.md — open to adjust based on ops feedback.
Olga: Monitoring checklist: p50/p95/p99 latency, 5xx rate, CPU/GPU memory pressure, KV cache hit rate. Proposal: page on p99>1200ms for >5m or 5xx rate >1% sustained for 10m.
Liz: Support flow: L1 support (CS) -> L2 oncall (platform) -> L3 eng owners. For GA we need a dedicated private-oncall rota for first 90 days. Ops to confirm headcount.
Ben: Pricing note: we should ship with 3 tiers: dev (pay-as-you-go), standard (commits + discounted tokens), enterprise (SLA + dedicated support). Need to lock min commit sizes and burst policy.
Jordan: Mitigations for noisy tenants: auto-throttle + fallback to compatible smaller model. @maya product must own the customer messaging about quality delta when fallback occurs.
Maya: Agreed. I'll draft an exact sentence for the docs: "During capacity fallbacks, workloads may be routed to lower‑capacity model variants; occasional increased latency and modest quality drift are expected." Will share.
Sam: Legal reminder: add explicit breach remediation timelines and credit calculation in SLA. Also include data residency clause for EU customers.
Olga: Runbook snippet for latency alert (to include in observability docs):
```
alert: Private_P99_Latency
expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, region))
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  runbook: /runbooks/private_p99_latency.md
```
Olga: Also add synthetic canaries per-region (every 5m) and a health-check metric that triggers an automated fallback if KV cache miss spike > 30% for 2m.
Liz: Escalation: page platform-oncall -> notify eng-sre -> if no ack in 15m, escalate to product oncall. Need playbook link in support KB.
Ben: Pricing operational: implement commit enforcement and metering window to prevent abuse. Also include grace burst credits for new customers (first 7 days).
Jordan: Owner matrix so we can close: Jordan = docs + rollout notes, Maya = customer messaging + support KB, Sam = SLA wording + legal sync, Olga = monitoring + runbooks, Liz = oncall + escalation, Ben = pricing. Can everyone ack?
Maya: ack :thumbsup:
Sam: ack, will sync with legal by EOD Thurs.
Olga: ack, will publish runbooks to /runbooks by EOD Fri.
Liz: ack — will coordinate oncall rota with ops.
Ben: ack — will finalize commit tiers and send numbers to pricing@list.
deploy-bot: reminder: release window scheduled Mon 02:00 UTC. Please ensure rollout checklist is in the release channel.
Jordan: Great — if no new blockers, I'll mark GA acceptance doc as ready for final review Friday AM. Thanks all.
